items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 7 at 7:33AM AKDT until October 7 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility as low as one-quarter mile in dense fog.

* WHERE...Central Copper Valley; Gulkana and north.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to low visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Dense fog has developed along the Richardson
Highway this morning. Fog in combination with temperatures below
freezing, may result in slippery road conditions and patchy black
ice. Fog will lift later this morning.
items.instruction:
A dense fog advisory means visibilities will frequently be reduced to
less than one quarter mile. If driving, slow down, use your
headlights, and leave plenty of distance ahead of you. Also, be alert
for frost on bridge decks and roadways causing slippery conditions.
